effects: Takes `amount` cbETH (the vault's collateral, 0xBe98…9704) from the signer via safeTransferFrom, using the signer's existing cbETH allowance to the vault.
Credits vault active shares to `onBehalfOf`, not necessarily the signer. The number of shares comes from the vault's stored stake and shares.
Reverts if `onBehalfOf` is zero, if the signer is not whitelisted while the whitelist is on, or if the deposit limit would be exceeded.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 cbETH for the beneficiary address into the named vault. The fields show the vault, the amount in cbETH and the beneficiary.

findings.title: deposit: the number of vault shares credited to onBehalfOf is not shown; it is computed from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_);` uses stored activeShares/activeStake. Not in the calldata, so no field can show it.

effects: Burns enough of the signer's active vault shares to cover `amount` cbETH. previewWithdraw rounds this up.
Moves `amount` cbETH of the signer's stake into the next epoch's withdrawal queue and credits the withdrawal shares to `claimer`. Only `claimer` can claim it once that epoch has passed.
No tokens move now. The queued amount can still be slashed until it is claimed.
formats.shown: Request a withdrawal of 2.5 cbETH from the vault, owned by the claim-owner address. The fields show the vault, the cbETH amount and the claim owner.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned and the delay before the claim opens are not shown; both come from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake());` and _withdraw: `uint256 epoch = currentEpoch() + 1;`. Both depend on stored state, not on calldata.
findings.fix: None needed beyond the 'Request withdrawal' intent, which already signals a queued withdrawal.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
Moves the matching cbETH (shares × activeStake / activeShares, rounded down) into the next epoch's withdrawal queue and credits the withdrawal shares to `claimer`, who can claim after that epoch.
No tokens move now. The queued amount can still be slashed until it is claimed.
formats.shown: Queue a raw 18-digit share count for withdrawal, owned by the claim-owner address. The fields show the vault, the raw shares and the claim owner.

findings.title: redeem: the share amount is an unscaled 18-digit integer; a non-expert cannot read how much is being queued.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem field `#.shares` has format `raw`, so case 2 shows "Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares". ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset() returns 0, so shares use the collateral's 18-decimal scale.
findings.fix: Use format `unit` with params {"decimals":18,"base":"shares"} so the screen reads ~0.9877 shares, and drop 'raw' from the label and the intent.

findings.title: redeem: the cbETH amount that the shares queue is not shown; it is computed from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares());`. This is not in the calldata.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. A note that the shares convert to cbETH would help the signer.

effects: Sends all of the signer's claimable cbETH for `epoch` from the vault to `recipient`.
Marks the signer's withdrawal for that epoch as claimed. Reverts if the epoch has not ended, was already claimed, or holds nothing.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawal for epoch 42 and send it to the recipient address. The fields show the vault, the raw epoch and the recipient.

findings.title: claim: the screen never says the asset sent to the recipient is cbETH.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);`. The descriptor's intent is "Claim withdrawal" and its interpolatedIntent is "Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}"; nothing names cbETH.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, e.g. "Claim cbETH withdrawal" and "Claim epoch {epoch} cbETH to {recipient}".

findings.title: claim: the cbETH amount sent to the recipient is read from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _claim: `amount = withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender);` reads the stored withdrawal shares.

effects: Sends the sum of the signer's claimable cbETH across all listed epochs from the vault to `recipient` in one transfer.
Marks each listed epoch as claimed for the signer. Reverts if any epoch is not yet ended, already claimed, or empty.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawals for epochs 42, 44 and 128 and send them to the recipient address. Each epoch is shown as its own field.

findings.title: claimBatch: the screen never says the asset sent to the recipient is cbETH.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);`. The descriptor's intent is "Claim withdrawals" and its interpolatedIntent is "Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}"; nothing names cbETH.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, e.g. "Claim cbETH withdrawals" and "Claim cbETH for epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}".

findings.title: claimBatch: the total cbETH sent to the recipient is read from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `amount += _claim(epochs[i]);`, where _claim reads withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender) from storage.
